## Verification of 05-build-spec.md and ADR 0001

I opened every cited line below and read it only. I ran no code from the scanned folders; my only script was a local Python text replace for the edits.

### The four extra checks

- **(a) Proposed things stated as existing.** 05 marks every command, hook and flag as Proposed. One slip was in the ADR: "Shadow mode cannot break a dispatch: the hook always exits 0 and prints nothing" spoke about a hook that does not exist yet as fact. Fixed.
- **(b) `measured` tags without a number.** Every `measured` tag I checked has a number at its cited line. Two are borderline (see "Left as is").
- **(c) Ranks and scores.** Both files match 04:119-127 exactly: 17 / 14 / 13 / 12 / 11 / 10 / 9. The roadmap's "04 rank N, score S" labels are also correct.
- **(d) One session.** Items 1–5 fit one session. Item 6 (writing 12 graded tasks with seeded defects, plus a smoke run where each baseline subagent pays the ~95k prefix) could overrun. I added a rule that it moves to R0 if so, rather than calling the scope wrong.

### Fixes applied

In `C:\Users\mariu\open source project\research\05-build-spec.md`:
1. §1 table: `02-projects-plugins.md:171-176` → `:174-179`.
2. §2.1: "unchanged at 113/116 in two runs" → "equal to the full-description arm in both runs (113/116, then 112/116)".
3. §3 reuse map: `02-projects-plugins.md:73` → `:76` (MIT).
4. §4.1 lean-report row: `02-projects-plugins.md:166` → `:169`.
5. §5.1 reference harnesses: `harness-bench/SKILL.md:4` → `:3`.
6. §5.1 repeats: "out of 124" → "out of 116 answerable queries".
7. §6: added one sentence: items 1–5 are the core, and item 6 moves to R0 if it would overrun the session (marked as a Proposed scoping rule).

In `C:\Users\mariu\open source project\docs\adr\0001-lean-dispatch-as-first-feature.md`:
1. Context: `02-projects-plugins.md:171-176` → `:174-179`.
2. Consequences: "cannot break a dispatch" → "is designed not to break a dispatch", citing the route_shadow skeleton (`~/neural-mesh/hooks/route_shadow.py:4`, `:111-113`; claimed, code read, not run).
3. Consequences: "The MVP fits one session" → "is scoped to fit one session, with the benchmark suite as the first item to defer".

In `C:\Users\mariu\open source project\research\02-projects-plugins.md`: line 1 now ends "(Phase 2)". Nothing else in 02 changed.

All citations keep real path:line references with full `~/` paths.

### Left as is (on purpose)

- **04-plugin-ideas.md:33** has the same "113/116 unchanged" overstatement. Out of scope: I may only edit 05 and the ADR.
- **05 §2.1** tags "<= 4 tools plus nested-queen's MCP set" (RD-LOG.md:379) as `measured`. It is a qualitative caveat; the only number is "4". It is harmless, so I did not retag it.
- **05 §8 risk 9**: "wrong more than half the time on novel phrasing (tool_ok .429)". The .429 is the dev set; the blind set is .400, and overall accuracy is .405/.350 (RD-LOG.md:301). The claim holds in substance.
- **05 §1** tags "~350 tokens per delegation" (RD-LOG.md:330) as `measured`, but line 330 restates the R76/R79 results rather than measuring them itself. The number is present, so I left it.
- **ledger.rs:166** uses `>=`, so on a tie the later chunk wins. "Keeping the largest output" is still accurate; no change.
